Stevie Wonder releases “My Cherie Amour” 57 years ago today — written when he was just 19, for a girlfriend he had while a student at the Michigan School for the Blind.

“.. Originally it was ‘Oh My Marsha’,” he said later. “We broke up, so it was a good thing they changed it.”
